description: This file defines classes and methods for testing the System Roles UI component in Mattermost's admin console, including role editing, privilege management, and assigned people panels using Playwright.

classes.name: SystemRoles
classes.description: Main class for interacting with the Role editing page in the system console, including panels for privileges and assigned people.

classes.name: PrivilegesPanel
classes.description: Represents the privileges section with multiple permission categories.

classes.name: PermissionSection
classes.description: Handles individual permission sections, allowing permission setting and subsections management.

classes.name: PermissionSubsection
classes.description: Represents subsections within permission sections, allowing permission adjustments.

classes.name: AssignedPeoplePanel
classes.description: Manages the panel listing assigned users, including search and pagination.

classes.name: AssignedUserRow
classes.description: Represents a row in the assigned users list, with methods to retrieve user info and remove users.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the main container or specific elements are visible.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Clicks the back link to navigate to the previous page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Clicks the save button to save changes.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Clicks the cancel button to discard changes.

methods.name: getRoleName
methods.description: Retrieves the role name text.

methods.name: getPermissionValue
methods.description: Gets the current permission setting for a section or subsection.

methods.name: setPermission
methods.description: Sets the permission level for a section or subsection.

methods.name: expandSubsections
methods.description: Expands subsections if collapsed.

methods.name: collapseSubsections
methods.description: Collapses subsections if expanded.

methods.name: hasSubsections
methods.description: Checks if subsections are visible.

methods.name: getSubsection
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subsection by name.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the panel or element is visible.

methods.name: clickAddPeople
methods.description: Clicks the button to add people.

methods.name: searchUsers
methods.description: Performs a search for users.

methods.name: clearSearch
methods.description: Clears the user search input.

methods.name: getUserCount
methods.description: Returns the number of user rows.

methods.name: getUserRowByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a user row by index.

methods.name: getUserRowByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a user row by username.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Gets the user's name.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Gets the user's email.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the user from the assigned list.
